spec.description:
Bradford Anticon Roofing Blanket is a premium Australian-made
glasswool insulation blanket factory-bonded to a reflective foil laminate
facing. Engineered specifically for residential and commercial metal roofs, it
combines thermal insulation, acoustic damping of heavy rain noise, and effective
condensation control in a single under-roof layer. It incorporates a 150mm foil
overlap edge to ensure a continuous vapour barrier, mitigating condensation
damage while offering bushfire ember protection up to BAL-FZ.
features:
3-in-1 solution: thermal insulation, acoustic rain noise damping, and
condensation control

Factory-bonded reflective foil laminate with a 150mm
overlap to seal vapor joints

Reduces heavy rain impact noise by up to 7 dB
(over 75% sound power reduction)

Non-combustible glasswool core compliant
with AS 1530.1

Suitable for bushfire attack levels from BAL 12.5 to BAL FZ
under AS 3959

Reduces radiant heat transfer into the roof space by up
to 97%

FBS-1 bio-soluble glasswool formulation approved by National Asthma
Council's Sensitive Choice

Available in thicknesses from 60mm to 145mm (R1.3
to R3.6)

Offered in Light Duty (LD), Medium Duty (MD), and Heavy Duty (HD)
foil grades
Australian made from up to 65% recycled glass

install:
Install roof safety wire mesh over purlins if required for
commercial spans or fall safety

Roll out Bradford Anticon blanket across or
down rafters/purlins with the foil facing down into the building and the
glasswool facing up

Allow a slight sag (approx 25-40mm) between supports to
avoid crushing the blanket against roof sheeting

Overlap consecutive runs of
Anticon by 150mm using the factory-provided foil overlap edge

Seal all
longitudinal and end overlaps thoroughly with matching reinforced aluminium foil
tape to maintain vapor barrier integrity

For roofs requiring roof spacers
(such as Ashgrid or SpacerX), install brackets and spacer bars over the
blanket

Fix metal roofing sheets directly over the blanket or spacer bars
without over-compressing the blanket over purlins
selection_checklist:
Confirm roof type (residential custom orb, trimdeck, or standing seam metal
roof)

Determine required total system R-value under NCC climate zone
requirements

Select foil duty (Light Duty for residential mesh/close battens,
Medium Duty for residential, Heavy Duty for commercial)

Confirm bushfire BAL
rating requirements (BAL 12.5 to BAL FZ)

Ensure matching 493 reinforced foil
tape is ordered for sealing overlaps
limitations:
Must be installed dry; do not install during
rain or leave exposed to weather before cladding

Foil must face downward
toward the ceiling/attic cavity to function as a vapor barrier and control
condensation

Avoid over-compressing blanket directly under roof sheets unless
using roof spacer systems

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Anticon Blanket is an Australian-made glasswool roofing
blanket factory-laminated to a reflective foil vapour-barrier backing with
a 150mm overlap edge. Designed for residential and commercial metal roofs, it
provides an all-in-one solution for thermal control (R1.3 to R3.6), rain impact
sound damping (reducing rain noise by up to 7 dB), and condensation management.
Featuring a non-combustible glasswool core (AS 1530.1) and suitability for
bushfire zones up to BAL-FZ, it protects roof timbers and ceilings from
moisture, heat, and flame.
